newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-ALBANIA TO FACE NORTHERN IRELAND IN ZURICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIA TO FACE NORTHERN IRELAND IN ZURICH.

text.p: The continuing unstable political situation in Albania has led to their World Cup group nine qualifier against Northern Ireland being switched to Zurich.
FIFA, world soccer's governing body, announced the decision on Thursday, adding that the September 10 match would be staged at the 25,000-seat Hardturm stadium, home ground of Grasshopper Zurich.
It is the third consecutive World Cup qualifer Albania will have to play away from home because of the political turmoil in the country.
They played two earlier "home" ties against Germany and the Ukraine in Granada, Spain. Both ended in defeat and several Albanian players defected, refusing to return home.
